title: No C_Encrypt OAEP test for flash/fsdir backend
description: test_rsa_oaep_vector_oracle tests C_Decrypt with flash backend keys but not C_Encrypt. The C_Encrypt OAEP non-soft backend fix (wolfp11work-4023) is completely untested. A regression in that path would ship silently. Need: add C_Encrypt call to the flash-backend OAEP test, use C_Encrypt to produce ciphertext then verify with oracle decrypt (wc_RsaPublicDecrypt + OAEP unpad, or python reference vector).
